record.name: Duros
record.description: Veteran spacers and navigators, Duros prize exploration and precision piloting, charting hyperlanes by instinct and experience.

innate_traits.name: Vacuum-Bred
innate_traits.narrative: Your species has evolved in space environments, developing natural adaptations that allow you to survive and thrive in the void where other species would perish.

mechanics.description: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws against vacuum exposure, zero gravity, and reduced-oxygen environments.

innate_traits.name: Keen Sight
innate_traits.narrative: Your large eyes have evolved to excel in the darkness of space, adapted to low light conditions and rapid motion detection.

innate_traits.name: Composed Under Fire
innate_traits.narrative: Your species' natural spacer heritage has given you the ability to remain calm and focused even in the most dangerous situations.

mechanics.name: Spacer's Composure
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, you gain advantage on a saving throw against fear or on a Piloting (Space) check.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Duros character. Emphasize their large, expressive eyes that seem to hold the knowledge of countless star systems, and their smooth, graceful movements that reflect their natural adaptation to space travel. Their skin should show the subtle variations common to their species. Consider their natural spacer heritage and the way they carry themselves with the confidence of those who know the void intimately.

class_synergies.narrative: Duros' natural spacer abilities and Vacuum-Bred physiology make them exceptional Scout pilots, able to navigate the most dangerous space environments with instinctive skill.
mechanical_benefits: Vacuum-Bred trait enhances survival in space environments
Composed Under Fire trait supports piloting under pressure
High Dexterity supports piloting and navigation

class_synergies.narrative: Duros' technical aptitude and spacer experience make them excellent Engineers, particularly in starship systems and space technology.
mechanical_benefits: High Intelligence supports technical skills and engineering
Vacuum-Bred trait aids in space-based engineering work
Keen Sight trait enhances precision work

class_synergies.narrative: Duros' natural agility and spacer skills make them excellent Operatives, able to navigate complex space stations and vessels with ease.
mechanical_benefits: High Dexterity supports Operative's agility-based abilities
Vacuum-Bred trait enhances survival in hostile environments
Keen Sight trait aids in reconnaissance

class_synergies.narrative: Duros' natural piloting abilities and spacer physiology make them exceptional Soldier pilots, able to handle combat situations in space with unmatched skill.
mechanical_benefits: Vacuum-Bred trait supports combat in space environments
Composed Under Fire trait enhances combat piloting
High Dexterity enhances piloting and combat abilities

faction_synergies.narrative: Duros are natural leaders in spacer guilds and organizations, using their extensive space travel experience to guide and protect other spacers.
Duros have served the Republic as pilots, navigators, and space explorers, their natural abilities making them valuable assets in space operations.
Many Duros prefer to work independently as free traders, explorers, and pilots, using their natural spacer abilities to chart their own course through the galaxy.

species_progression.base_description: Your species has evolved in space environments, developing natural adaptations that allow you to survive and thrive in the void where other species would perish.

level_5.description: Your space adaptations have grown stronger. You can survive in even more extreme space environments.

level_10.description: Your space mastery has become legendary. You can navigate and survive in any space environment.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can automatically succeed on any space-related saving throw or check

level_15.description: You have become a master of space environments. Your abilities in the void are unparalleled.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can grant space adaptation abilities to allies for 1 hour

level_20.description: You are a living legend of space exploration. Your mastery of the void transcends normal limitations.

mechanical_effect.description: Once per long rest, you can create a temporary space environment or survive any space hazard

narrative_progression.level_5: As you navigate the complexities of space, your instincts and experiences guide you in charting hyperlanes with increasing precision.
narrative_progression.level_10: Your reputation as a skilled navigator and pilot spreads throughout the galaxy, earning you invitations to join prestigious explorer's guilds and pilot elite starships.
narrative_progression.level_15: You begin to develop a deeper understanding of the intricate balance between space travel and exploration, using your knowledge to discover new hyperspace routes and uncharted territories.
narrative_progression.level_20: Your mastery of navigation and piloting reaches unprecedented heights as you lead expeditions into the unknown, blazing new trails through the galaxy and earning yourself legendary status among spacers.

cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can draw upon the ancient spacer traditions of your people, understanding space navigation in ways that seem almost instinctive.

cultural_features.description: Your species' natural curiosity and drive to explore the unknown reaches of space.

cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You can channel your species' natural explorer spirit, finding hidden paths and discovering secrets that others might miss.

cultural_features.name: Pilot's Instinct

cultural_features.name: Technician's Touch

Piloting starships and operating space vehicles with precision
Exploring new areas and charting unknown territories

Expertise in zero-gravity environments, including space acrobatics and void navigation
In-depth understanding of starship systems, life support management, and ship maintenance

environmental_adaptations.advantage: Natural expertise in space environments and void survival
environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: You move through space environments with natural ease, your species' evolutionary adaptation to the void making you perfectly at home in the emptiness between stars.

environmental_adaptations.immersion_effect: Your natural spacer heritage makes you perfectly at home in starship environments, understanding ship systems and operations instinctively.

emergence.description: A Duros navigator challenges you to a hyperlane charting competition.

escalation.description: You and the Duros navigator engage in a heated argument over navigation techniques.

confrontation.description: The Duros navigator accuses you of sabotaging their ship's hyperdrive.
confrontation.reward: -5d6 damage to your ship in the next combat encounter
confrontation.consequence: Banished from Duros space for 1 month

resolution_paths.victory: You convince the Duros navigator that your methods are superior.
resolution_paths.redemption: You apologize and make amends with the Duros navigator.
resolution_paths.escape: You flee the scene before things escalate further.

conflict_triggers: The player's piloting skills are significantly lower than the Duros navigator's
The player tries to steal or sabotage a Duros ship
The player refuses to share navigation data with the Duros navigator

formation_triggers: Duros navigator accuses you of stealing their charts
You reject the Duros navigator's offer to collaborate on a charting project

overrides.historical_enemy: Krayt Clan (a notorious group of pirate spacers that plagued Duros navigation efforts for generations)
overrides.tragic_flaw: A deep-seated fear of being trapped or confined, stemming from their early experiences navigating through treacherous asteroid fields.

record.flavor_text: Born on the unforgiving planet of Duro, a world ravaged by constant sandstorms and harsh twin suns, the Duros have developed an unwavering passion for exploration. Their early history is etched with tales of navigating through treacherous asteroid fields and charting new hyperspace routes to avoid rival pirate clans. To this day, Duros pilots remain renowned for their exceptional navigational skills, unflinching in the face of danger and relying on intuition honed from generations of experience.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Duro, you embody the spirit of exploration and precision piloting. You're driven by an insatiable curiosity about the galaxy's uncharted territories and often find yourself at odds with those who value caution over risk-taking. Be mindful of your tendency to push boundaries and challenge authority, as this can sometimes lead to friction with fellow crew members or even law enforcement.
narrative_hooks: A mysterious hyperspace route that promises unparalleled efficiency in travel times but requires navigating through an unstable asteroid field.
A cryptic transmission from a long-lost Duro clan leader, hinting at the existence of a hidden planet with untold riches and ancient knowledge.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Duros are known for their loose social hierarchy, valuing expertise over position. However, this can sometimes lead to tension among crew members as they jockey for influence and decision-making power. Be aware that your reputation as a skilled pilot may earn you respect, but also attract attention from rival clans or opportunistic smugglers.
common_motivations: Acquiring the latest in navigational technology to stay ahead of competitors.
Uncovering hidden secrets about their clan's past and the forgotten history of Duro.

ai_behavior.combat_behavior: Supports allies with precision strikes, prioritizing long-range damage.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: Favors direct communication, using charts and data to build trust.

overrides.courtship_customs: Duros often form close bonds with travel companions or fellow crew members during long voyages. They value shared experiences and trust built over time, making courtship a gradual process.
overrides.mate_selection_cues: A Duro may show interest by inviting you to share stories of their navigational exploits or offer cryptic hints about hidden hyperspace routes.
